<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>New Zealand-India FTA:</strong> The New Zealand Parliament has passed a landmark Free Trade Agreement with India, which is expected to slash tariffs on 95% of Indian exports and boost bilateral investment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I38</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I54</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Supreme Court Oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court is currently hearing challenges regarding the Election Commission&#x27;s handling of the Shiv Sena party symbol, a plea for a standard election manifesto format, and a PIL contesting the new merchant fee framework for UPI transactions over ₹2,000.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I63</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I69</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNZDNfQWpSTUcyNWctbFM2X1VPeWhZTnBhdE1rMFRSVkhWZWxLUDJpeHVocG1rZWVaX2ZuR0hmWFR1aWtVMWcyOWJsRzl5c1Uwam5rdHFfVUk5UEd5R29tSEdsZnNWb211V2FkZXh0dmRmNUF4MERBeHVoWWtFa0lTaDgyeXF1NWlaejY0NjA1VkdHRUtUY1FaWTB6dnN2WENZYUp3dkNzOWZhYzNnVWc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I71</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPZWpwWld2b0VzQ0lYUUF5bzlKQXdtTjJ6S3dSWS1NYkZ4SmJLYWIyV2p1eTJvTWJfYkFXS0JjaFJaSHN3bVl2Z3VfQ2t5aDRSdmtPQVZveWcxdnV3VElUbW1iVUhpZjJ4aURMMzVDdnlady10SktEMWtIR2hCN29ZWUZoUUltUnN4ZTd4MkppM29YLUxRZlE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I91</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNT2JiX0QtRzBqdzRtQTkyS0I1TjdfZGFBZnh2VDllM2VYSUJuUUU0Z0ZLYnVHMHRzeGZGcnNyM3h6V3E2dDNHaTFENnZvSHJxWUZ5Z25OMHhJd1FuZUFMRy1panZxTU5Qdm1UMzRUMFJ6YzVsQjVsTEZxSlhCUlRKYjlqRWJQcXBIUTdWanVWWDhEUzR1OTdmRU5sZnZSM3VsTzl2T2xJUVZ1anNqLWdrZlVTbURPSFU?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I93</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Menstrual Hygiene Compliance:</strong> The Supreme Court has expressed dissatisfaction with state-level implementation of menstrual hygiene standards in schools, ordering surprise inspections and mandating the use of compostable rather than oxo-biodegradable sanitary napkins.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I81</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I83</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I86</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>EPFO Wage Ceiling:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved an increase in the Employees&#x27; Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) wage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month to expand mandatory social security coverage.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political Milestones:</strong> The Union Cabinet passed a formal resolution congratulating Prime Minister Narendra Modi for becoming the longest-serving elected Prime Minister in India&#x27;s history.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
</ul>
